brief:
Director Jamie Roberts acknowledged a "serious mistake" in the controversial BBC documentary "Gaza: How to Survive a Warzone," The Guardian reported. Roberts maintained, however, that the stories featured in the film remain important and should still reach audiences, even after the broadcaster pulled the program.

The documentary faced criticism that led to its withdrawal from BBC platforms. Roberts is now working on a new film addressing the UK far right, while the status of the Gaza stories remains unresolved.

title: BBC Gaza documentary director says pulled stories still deserve airing
